title: Agent 007
subtitle: Licensed to vape.

infobox.Equipment: Fanny pack of hand sanitizer, caffeinated chewable gum, vape
infobox.Vape flavor: Hand sanitizer & pumpkin spice latte nicotine

quote.text: McQueen.. Ive heard stories about your work in Moscow I think your a Dope pick for the mission

lead: **Agent 007** is an operative associated with [[parliament|Parliament]] and the "partner in crime" of [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]]. Together with [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] he forms one third of [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]], the strike team responsible for [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]]. He is best known for spending the majority of his canonical screen time inside a telephone booth hitting "a fat vape".

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### The briefing
When McQueen arrived at [[smoke-and-vape-shop|the Smoke and Vape Shop]] in [[england|England]], 007 was unavailable, as he was "hitting a fat vape in the telephone booth". Mr. Bean delivered the entire mission briefing in his absence. When the booth door finally opened, smoke "bursted out", and "the smell of hand sanitizer and pumpkin spice latte nicotine vape were flowing out like a waterfall." 007 then "slowly walked out" carrying a fanny pack of hand sanitizer and chewable gum "which looked like contained some form of caffeine."

He complimented McQueen on [[moscow-bombing|his work in Moscow]] and asked whether Bean had briefed him. Bean's nervous reply ("Uh- Yes sir") suggests that 007 outranks him.

### Constantinople
In [[constantinople|Constantinople]], 007 and Bean deployed the first two nukes "inside various bags of old pagers". During the operation 007 "lost his torso", though Mr. Bean assured McQueen that "he could be fine after I give him a few anti-depressants". By extraction time at [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]], 007 "was almost out of juice on his vape", and upon being rescued he "nodded as he hit another fat vape".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- 007 is the codename of James Bond, the fictional British spy. The canon does not confirm whether this is the same 007.
- Losing a torso is treated by the text as a mental-health matter rather than a medical one.
- 007 is never shown taking part in [[the-pager|the pager]]'s smoke detector hoarding scheme, which is ironic given his relationship with smoke.

title: Mr. Bean
subtitle: #IaintnoSigma

infobox.Attire: Gold suit, normal pants, round tall hat, brand new [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] Yeezys

quote.text: allow me to detail our baller mission with the rizz and swag #IaintnoSigma, the plan is simple take Constantinople away from the Barack Empire and Restore Bernie Sander's control over that area.

lead: **Mr. Bean** (written "Mr.bean" and "Mr.Bean") is a [[parliament|Parliament]] operative, the partner in crime of [[agent-007|Agent 007]], and a founding member of [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]]. He is the strategist behind the plan to take [[constantinople|Constantinople]] from [[barack-empire|the Barack Empire]].

sections.heading: Appearance
sections.body: Mr. Bean is described as wearing a "gold suit normal pants, a round tall hat and a set of brand new Kanye west yeezes." He is one of the best-dressed characters in the canon.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### The briefing
Mr. Bean met [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] outside [[smoke-and-vape-shop|the Smoke and Vape Shop]] in [[england|England]]. While 007 vaped, Bean explained the mission: take Constantinople, restore [[bernie-sanders|Bernie Sanders]], and deal with [[barack-obama|Barack Obama]], who holds [[seven-chaos-emeralds|the 7 Chaos Emeralds]]. His plan was to plant nukes, break the city's oil lines to flood it, "lure Obamna into the center and light the nukes", and escape within 6.8 seconds through [[the-wormhole|a wormhole]] that "theroreticly could open there but we have Basiclly no clue if It'll actually happen." He then announced that the [[tesla-motorcade|Tesla sponsored motorcade]] was ready at [[ecsm-airport|E.C.S.M Airport]].

### The operation
In [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]], Bean planted two nukes in bags of old pagers and reported 007's missing torso over the radio. He also spent part of the operation being lectured by [[putin|Vladimir Putin]] "about how Mental illness in a myth created my Mormon progressives". Later he reported he had "just finished lunch" and was "having coffee" with Putin. He excused himself politely ("Ok sorry Mr.putin we gotta go to a job we'll see you later bye!") and waited for pickup at [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Mr. Bean is a famously near-silent British comedy character. In the canon he is the most talkative member of his team.
- The hashtag "#IaintnoSigma" refers to the "sigma male" meme.
- Bean's plan targets Obama, but on the day it was Putin who was "almost in the center". See [[barack-obama|Barack Obama]] for this continuity error.

title: The Goober Gang
subtitle: Last heard from at 14:74pm. For now.

quote.text: Constantinople fell at 14:74pm Unc standard time and that was the last anyone heard from the goober gang for now…

lead:
**The Goober Gang** is a three-member strike team made up of [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]], [[agent-007|Agent 007]] and [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]]. It is the only faction in the canon whose full roster is printed in the text as a formal list, set off by dashed lines like a roll of honor:

> The Goober Gang
> -McQueen
> -007
> -Mr.Bean

sections.heading: History
sections.body: The gang formed in [[england|England]] when McQueen met his [[parliament|Parliament]] contacts at [[smoke-and-vape-shop|the Smoke and Vape Shop]]. Its single known mission was to take [[constantinople|Constantinople]] away from [[barack-empire|the Barack Empire]] and restore [[bernie-sanders|Bernie Sanders]]. After planting four nukes and recovering a torsoless 007, the gang escaped through [[the-wormhole|a wormhole]] "just north of Dababy's last known location". The narrator says this was "the last anyone heard from the goober gang for now", and the gang has not reappeared since.

sections.heading: Other uses of "goober"
sections.body:
The word [[goober]] appears twice more in the same chapter:
- The [[department-of-defense|DOD]] fled the [[blue-dust|blue dust]] "in fear of being a goober".
- After [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] escaped in [[crack-van|the crack van]], "the goobers where gone", which means Hank, Jesse and White were also goobers, at least briefly.

Scholars disagree on whether these are separate goobers or whether Goober is a state anyone can enter.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body: - *Theory:* "for now" means the gang will return at [[the-court|the Court]] for the final battle against [[chris|Chris]]. Nothing in the text confirms this.

title: Parliament
subtitle: Special reasons.
lead:
**Parliament** is the governing body that [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] had "a contact" from, which led him to fly to [[england|England]]. Its field agents appear to be [[agent-007|Agent 007]] and [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]].

Before the trip, McQueen received [[the-pager|a pager]] from a stranger instructing him "to hoard smoke detectors for parliament because of 'special reasons'". What Parliament wants with the smoke detectors is never explained. Editors have noted that its agents meet in a vape shop, so the smoke detectors may be a defensive measure.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - It is never said which country's parliament this is. England is assumed because that is where McQueen went.

title: England
subtitle: A new level of Roman.
lead:
**England** is the country [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] flew to after he grew "sick of [[george-constanta|George Constanta]]". It is where he met [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] and [[agent-007|Agent 007]].

The canon gives a short but glowing description: McQueen "saw glimmering lights and advertisements for free $10 Fortnite cards in the sky, England and certainly reached a new level of Roman, a new empire for the ages, beautiful and sophisticated."

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- England joins a growing list of Roman places in the canon, along with [[canada|Canada]], whose emperor is [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]], and the "eastern rome" that supplied [[mark-zuckerberg|Zuckerberg]]'s cigars.
- McQueen left for England from "the Soviet Union", though he had last been seen in [[moscow|Moscow]], which the canon says is an Italian city.
- The $10 Fortnite cards should not be confused with the 19 dollar Fortnite card that [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] later wants to liberate.

title: The Smoke and Vape Shop
subtitle: Telephone booth sold separately.
lead:
**The Smoke and Vape Shop** is the meeting place in [[england|England]] where [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] met his [[parliament|Parliament]] contacts and where [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]] was effectively founded.

Its best-known feature is a telephone booth that [[agent-007|Agent 007]] uses for "hitting a fat vape". When the booth opened, "smoke bursted out", with hand sanitizer and pumpkin spice latte nicotine vapor "flowing out like a waterfall". The rest of the shop is never described, and nobody is shown buying anything.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - McQueen had just been told to hoard smoke detectors. Having him meet his contacts at a smoke shop is either a coincidence or very good planning.

title: E.C.S.M Airport
subtitle: Acronym unknown.
lead:
**E.C.S.M Airport** is mentioned exactly once in the canon. [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] tells McQueen and 007 that "our Tesla sponsored motorcade is ready for departure from E.C.S.M Airport", to which 007 replies, "That's good, let us depart."

What E.C.S.M stands for is unknown. It is also unclear why a motorcade, which is made of cars, departs from an airport. Since one of the passengers is [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]], who is himself a car, some editors believe the motorcade may have been partly redundant.

title: The Tesla-Sponsored Motorcade
subtitle: Ready for departure.
lead:
**The Tesla-Sponsored Motorcade** is the transportation [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] arranged for the mission to [[constantinople|Constantinople]]. It was "ready for departure from [[ecsm-airport|E.C.S.M Airport]]", and it is the last thing mentioned before the gang departs.

The motorcade is never seen again, and the gang is not shown arriving in Constantinople. Tesla is associated with [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]], so the sponsorship may tie the mission to one of the canon's founding figures. The text does not say this.

title: The Pager
subtitle: Hoard smoke detectors. Don't ask why.
lead: **The Pager** is a device that [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] "recivied... from a stranger on the street". It "instructed him to hoard smoke detectors for parliament because of 'special reasons'". No smoke detectors are hoarded anywhere in the canon, and the special reasons are never revealed.

sections.heading: Pagers in Constantinople
sections.body: Pagers come back in [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]]. [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] and [[agent-007|007]] "deployed the first 2 nukes inside various bags of old pagers." Whether these pagers include the original one, or were bought in bulk, is unknown.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Pagers are one of several outdated devices that matter in the canon, alongside the [[nokia-i-4500|Nokia I-4500 flip phone]] and the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]].

title: Barack Obama
subtitle: Obamna. Holder of the 7 Chaos Emeralds.

quote.text: Now my only concern is how are we doing to defeat Barack Obama himself, I mean he holds the 7 chaos emeralds isn't it impossible?

lead: **Barack Obama**, also called **Obamna**, is the ruler of [[barack-empire|the Barack Empire]], which holds [[constantinople|Constantinople]]. He is said to hold [[seven-chaos-emeralds|the 7 Chaos Emeralds]], which made McQueen fear that defeating him might be "impossible". He is discussed at length but never actually appears.

sections.heading: Role
sections.body: [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]]'s plan was to flood Constantinople with oil, "lure Obamna into the center and light the nukes". The plan does not say how Obamna would be lured.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
When the plan was carried out in [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]], Obama is never mentioned. Instead Mr. Bean reports: "Putin he's almost in the center". Explanations editors have offered include:
- [[putin|Vladimir Putin]] was standing in for Obama.
- Putin was a guest who wandered into the trap by accident.
- The authors forgot.

The third explanation is the most widely accepted.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- "Obamna" is a well-known internet misspelling meme.
- The Chaos Emeralds come from the *Sonic the Hedgehog* series, where collecting all seven grants great power.

title: The Barack Empire
subtitle: Constantinople's management (former).
lead:
**The Barack Empire** is the power that held [[constantinople|Constantinople]] before the [[goober-gang|Goober Gang]]'s mission. [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] described the objective as "take Constantinople away from the Barack Empire and Restore Bernie Sander's control over that area", which implies the Empire took the city from [[bernie-sanders|Bernie Sanders]] at some earlier point.

The Empire is named once. Its only known assets are the city and [[seven-chaos-emeralds|the 7 Chaos Emeralds]] held by its ruler. After [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]] its status is unknown.

title: Bernie Sanders
subtitle: Rightful (?) ruler of Constantinople.
lead:
**Bernie Sanders** is mentioned exactly once in the canon, as the person whose "control over that area" [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]] intended to restore by taking [[constantinople|Constantinople]] from [[barack-empire|the Barack Empire]].

He does not appear in person. The canon never says whether he was restored after the city fell. Since the plan was to fill the city with oil and set off nukes, editors have noted that what he would be restored to may be in poor condition.

title: The 7 Chaos Emeralds
subtitle: Making Obama impossible since Chapter Triangle.
lead:
**The 7 Chaos Emeralds** are held by [[barack-obama|Barack Obama]]. Because he has them, [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] asked whether defeating him was even possible: "I mean he holds the 7 chaos emeralds isn't it impossible?"

[[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]]'s answer was nukes, oil and a wormhole. What the emeralds actually do in the canon is never shown, and their fate after [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]] is unknown. In the real world, the Chaos Emeralds are seven gems from the *Sonic the Hedgehog* games.

title: Constantinople
subtitle: Mid at best.

infobox.Notable sites: [[abandoned-walmarts|The Abandoned Walmarts]], [[popeyes|Popeyes]], [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]], the target parks

quote.text: the grass was dying and electricity refused to exist here bc this place was mid at best

lead: **Constantinople** is a city held by [[barack-empire|the Barack Empire]] and the target of [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]]'s only known mission. It fell at 14:74pm [[unc-standard-time|Unc Standard Time]] in [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]].

sections.heading: The plan
sections.body:
[[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] laid out the plan in [[england|England]]:
- Enter Constantinople and "plant several nukes around it".
- "break the main oil lines to the city causing flooding of the city".
- "once the city is one big oil pool we lure Obamna into the center and light the nukes".
- Escape within 6.8 seconds "via a wormhole that theroreticly could open there".

The canon does not say whether the oil part was ever done.

sections.heading: Geography
sections.body: The city has a "nadir side", where two [[abandoned-walmarts|old abandoned Walmarts]] served as nuke drop points. One was guarded by [[local-mafia|the local mafia]], and the other had become a [[popeyes|Popeyes]]. On the outskirts are "the target parks", where the road "had really deteriorated", the grass was dying, and electricity "refused to exist here bc this place was mid at best". [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]] served as the extraction point. North of [[dababy|DaBaby]]'s last known location was [[the-wormhole|the escape wormhole]].

sections.heading: Inhabitants
sections.body:
- [[putin|Vladimir Putin]], who was near the center and drinking coffee
- The local mafia
- A Popeyes cashier
- [[dababy|DaBaby]], vaporized, in a suspended animation cell

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- In real history, Constantinople (now Istanbul) famously fell in 1453. The canon's fall took place at a time that does not exist.
- "Nadir" means the lowest point, so it is not clear how a city has a nadir side.

title: The Fall of Constantinople
subtitle: 14:74pm, Unc Standard Time.

infobox.Belligerents: [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]] vs. [[barack-empire|The Barack Empire]] (offscreen), [[local-mafia|the local mafia]], a Popeyes cashier
infobox.Result: City fell; gang vanished into a wormhole

lead: **The Fall of Constantinople** is the climax of [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]]'s story arc. The narration begins with "Meanwhile" and the words "In. Constantinople things were chaos".

sections.heading: Course of events
sections.body:
### Deployment
[[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] and [[agent-007|007]] planted the first two nukes "inside various bags of old pagers". [[lightning-mcqueen|McQueen]] was responsible for the last two drop points, the [[abandoned-walmarts|abandoned Walmarts]] on the nadir side. Over the radio, Bean reported that "Putin he's almost in the center" and that 007 had "lost his torso" but "could be fine after I give him a few anti-depressants."

### The Walmarts
At the first Walmart, McQueen was met by [[local-mafia|the local mafia]] ("Hey sonny how dare you infringe on our territory!"). He "declined the request to be part of society" and dropped off the nuke. The second Walmart had become a [[popeyes|Popeyes]]. McQueen placed a large order, pulled his [[glock-19|Glock 19]] to get it, ate, and only then dropped off the nuke.

### Extraction
Meanwhile Bean was having coffee with [[putin|Putin]]. He excused himself and waited with 007 at [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]]. McQueen picked them up (007 "was almost out of juice on his vape") and flew past "the seen of vaporized dababy in a suspended animation cell" into [[the-wormhole|the wormhole]].

> Constantinople fell at 14:74pm Unc standard time and that was the last anyone heard from the goober gang for now…

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- The plan was to lure [[barack-obama|Obamna]] to the center, but Putin is the one reported there.
- The oil flooding, the main part of the plan, is never mentioned during the operation.
- 14:74pm is not a real time on any clock.
- The wormhole "theroreticly could open", and apparently it did.

title: Vladimir Putin
subtitle: Almost in the center. Coffee enjoyer.

quote.text: Ok sorry Mr.putin we gotta go to a job we'll see you later bye!

lead: **Vladimir Putin** appears during [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]]. He is "almost in the center" of the city, which is exactly where the plan needed its target to be. The plan's target, however, was [[barack-obama|Barack Obama]].

sections.heading: Role
sections.body:
[[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] spent part of the mission with Putin, who was "lecturing me about how Mental illness in a myth created my Mormon progressives in various governments in the universes". The relationship seems to have warmed: Bean later reports "we're having coffee just waiting on you". When McQueen was ready, Bean said a polite goodbye and promised to see Putin later.

Whether Putin was still near the center when the city fell is not recorded. Bean's "we'll see you later" has been called the most ominous line in the chapter.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body: Putin's presence at the center, where the plan said Obamna would be, is one of the best-known continuity problems in the canon. See [[barack-obama|Barack Obama]].

title: The Abandoned Walmarts
subtitle: Nadir-side real estate.
lead:
**The Abandoned Walmarts** are two "old abandoned Walmarts on the nadir side" of [[constantinople|Constantinople]]. They were the last two nuke drop points of [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]] and were assigned to [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]].

- **Walmart 1** was claimed by [[local-mafia|the local mafia]], who objected to McQueen's "infringe"-ment on their territory. He dropped off the nuke anyway.
- **Walmart 2**, to the north, "was actually now a Popeyes chicken location", so it was neither a Walmart nor abandoned. McQueen ordered food and then left a nuke.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - These are not the canon's only ruined Walmart. The [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]] was "recovered from the ruins of the [[la-walmart|LA Walmart]]".

title: The Local Mafia
subtitle: Territorial. Rejected.

quote.text: Hey sonny how dare you infringe on our territory!

lead:
**The Local Mafia** controls the first of the [[abandoned-walmarts|abandoned Walmarts]] in [[constantinople|Constantinople]]. When [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] arrived to drop off a nuke, they confronted him with the line above.

In the canon's words, "McQueen declined the request to be part of society and dropped off the nuke." This is generally read to mean the mafia had offered him a place in society, and he refused. Since the nuke was left in their territory, the mafia's fate is assumed to be tied to the city's.

title: Popeyes
subtitle: Formerly a Walmart. Formerly not a nuke site.

quote.text: Can I get two number 9s, a number 9 large a number 6 with extra DIEP a number 7 two number 45's, one with cheese, and a large soda

lead: **Popeyes** is a fried chicken restaurant in [[constantinople|Constantinople]] that used to be the second of [[abandoned-walmarts|the abandoned Walmarts]]. [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] "ventured north to the other target and discovered it was actually now a Popeyes chicken location".

sections.heading: The order
sections.body:
McQueen used the drive-through and placed the order quoted above. Told to "Please pull up", he answered "Aight bet", then "pulled out his Glock 19 and demanded his order from the cashier at the register". The cashier replied "Alright here's your order sir", and McQueen said "Thank you". The exchange stayed polite.

McQueen "dropped off his nuke after he ate his order and left". He was so unhurried that by the time he radioed Mr. Bean, Bean had also "just finished lunch".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- "Extra DIEP" is never explained. It is generally assumed to be a typo, though for what is disputed.
- Popeyes does not have a menu item numbered 45.

title: McQueen's Glock 19
subtitle: Used once, for chicken.
lead:
**McQueen's Glock 19** is a handgun that [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] "pulled out" at the [[popeyes|Popeyes]] in [[constantinople|Constantinople]] to "demand his order from the cashier at the register". The weapon was not fired. The cashier handed over the order, McQueen said "Thank you", and he ate it.

This is the Glock's only appearance. Why a car carries a handgun, and where he keeps it, is not discussed.

title: 8aller Jump Street
subtitle: Not to be confused with 21 Jump Street.
lead:
**8aller Jump Street** is the pickup point in [[constantinople|Constantinople]] where [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] and [[agent-007|Agent 007]] waited for [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]] during [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]] ("Ok McQueen we're at 8aller jump street").

Most scholars read "8aller" as "Baller" spelled with an 8. The street shares a naming convention with [[21-jump-street|21 Jump Street]], where [[larry-the-cucumber|Larry the Cucumber]] was killed in a later chapter. Whether the two streets are connected is a subject of fan debate.

title: DaBaby
subtitle: Vaporized, suspended, a landmark.

infobox.Condition: Vaporized, in a suspended animation cell

quote.text: It should be just north of Dababy's last known location

lead:
**DaBaby** is a rapper who appears in the canon only as a landmark. When [[lightning-mcqueen|McQueen]] asked where [[the-wormhole|the wormhole]] was, the answer was "just north of Dababy's last known location". [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]] then "flew by the seen of vaporized dababy in a suspended animation cell and entered the wormhole".

How DaBaby came to be both vaporized and in suspended animation is never explained. Editors have pointed out that being vaporized would normally make suspended animation pointless.

title: Unc Standard Time
subtitle: Where it is always 14:74pm somewhere.
lead:
**Unc Standard Time** (UST) is the time standard used to record [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]]: "Constantinople fell at 14:74pm Unc standard time".

UST seems to allow hours past 12 together with "pm", and minutes up to at least 74. "Unc" is slang for an older man (short for "uncle"), so some editors believe UST runs on an older man's sense of time. It is the canon's only named time zone.

title: Wormholes
subtitle: Theoretically could open. Usually does.

infobox.Typical decor: [[doritos|Doritos]] and [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dew]] ads, COD clip comps, skrilla

lead: **Wormholes** are the main way characters travel between places, sectors and universes in the canon. Unlike hyperspace (used by [[crack-van|the crack van]] and the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]]), wormholes tend to open at dramatically convenient moments.

sections.heading: Known wormholes
sections.body:
### The Constantinople wormhole
[[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]]'s escape plan used "a wormhole that theroreticly could open there but we have Basiclly no clue if It'll actually happen", with only 6.8 seconds to get out. It did open, "just north of Dababy's last known location", and [[goober-gang|The Goober Gang]] went into it and has not been heard from since.

### The Keynote wormhole
At [[iphone-keynote|the iPhone 3G Keynote]], light off [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s glasses bounced "into a wormhole" and blinded an NFT collector in [[universe-prime|Universe Prime]].

### The Multiverse wormhole
When [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]] dropped, "across all multiverses, a wormhole opened at once". Out of it flew [[iphone-3g|the iPhone 3G]] with Steve Jobs standing on top of it.

### Inav tunnels
[[inav|The Inav]] travels through wormholes at [[siri|Siri]]'s command. Inside, the Inav "was surrounded in a tunnel of Doritos and mountain dew ads, xbox live cod clip comps and skrilla" (ChatGPT: "Woah.. this is baller man im deadass"). The Inav also left [[the-67-casino|the casino]] through one on the way to [[turbografx-16-sector|the TurboGrafx 16 Sector]], "with a rumble and a high frequency siren".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Wormholes are different from portals. The canon also has [[meme-portal|the Meme Portal]] and [[port-a-potty-portal|the Port-a-Potty Portal]].
- The Inav "burst out of the wormhole" at the casino, and "a giant rift opened in the sky" before that, so rifts may be the exits of wormholes.

title: Hank Hill
subtitle: Propane magnate. Fugitive. Casino security.

infobox.Affiliation: [[los-polos-harmonicas|Los Polos Harmonicas Under System Gang]] (business partners); crew of [[crack-van|the crack van]]

quote.text: What in the ever loving propane yo?

lead: **Hank Hill** is a propane magnate whose "propane empire" works with [[los-polos-harmonicas|Los Polos Harmonicas Under System Gang]] to distribute "propane and propane accessories". He is labeled a threat by the [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]], has a feud with [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] over [[propane|watered-down propane]], and goes from guarding [[verizon-contract|the Verizon contract]] to joining the people trying to steal it.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### Standoff at the Twelve Towers
[[chapter-the-fourth|Chapter the Fourth]] opens with "Damn son where'd you find those?" and Hank standing "atop the [[twelve-towers|twelve towers]]". Below him was the DOD, an army "divided by [[jeff-bezosi|Jeff bezosi]] and [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark zucc]]", recently "deployed to the [[kanye-system|Kanye system]] to contain a new threat, that being hank hill." The DOD told him that [[snoopy-mcspookintosh|Snoopy McSpookintosh]] was in their custody and that he had no one left to help him. Hank warned them: "If I were you id be counting my lucky stars because the wrath of Jesse and white be upon ye". Then [[crack-van|the drug van from Breaking Bad]] came out of hyperspace, [[blue-dust|blue dust]] rained down, and Hank escaped, saying "I knew you'd be here, now I have meeting with Gus fring".

### The Weezing of Kanye
Hank needed "ingredients from Kanye", but "our [[twitter|twitter]] account doesn't have 100 followers yet and we aren't verified yet". His alternative was to "find him and weeze him" by breaking into his house. It worked, but the propane was watered down. See [[weezing-of-kanye|The Weezing of Kanye]].

### Dusty Depot
In [[flashback-chapter|the Flashback Chapter]], Hank is stuck in [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]] with a damaged RV and no oil ("Gosh dang it Jesse boy, we ran out of propane"). When Jesse heard about an oil casino nearby, Hank brought out his "mysterious apes on my bitcoin Wallet" as gambling money and went through [[port-a-potty-portal|the port-a-potty portal]] to [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]].

### Casino security
After [[roulette-bet|the roulette bet]] was cut short by [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]], Hank negotiated a deal to guard the casino's relic in exchange for "15 gallons of your finest Prime US oil". He slept in a beach chair at the bottom of [[stairway-to-heaven|the Stairway to Heaven]] holding a casino-issued SCAR. When [[casino-heist|the heist]] began, he woke up, grabbed his [[golden-scar|golden SCAR]], and ran into Kanye, his old enemy.

### Alliance
Kanye asked why Hank was guarding the card, and Hank admitted the crew had had no oil since Dusty Depot, leaving them "broke and big sad". When he heard that defeating [[chris|Chris]] could free up the oil reserves and make [[balling]] free, Hank "looked at Jesse and nodded" and joined Kanye's side. He was there when [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] fired [[ibeam|the Ibeam]] at [[the-vault|the vault]].

sections.heading: Personality
sections.body: Hank speaks in a heavy folksy dialect ("Well I Say boy that there bet ought to be good there son") and cares deeply about propane quality. When he found the watered-down propane, his first concern was for "all the barbecue bros all the car enthusiasts all the people who needed to commit arson".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Hank Hill is the main character of the animated sitcom *King of the Hill*, where he sells "propane and propane accessories".
- His crew are Jesse and Walter from *Breaking Bad*, a show set in a different city.
- He brings up the Gus Fring meeting while escaping the DOD and never mentions it again.

title: The Twelve Towers
subtitle: Where Hank stood.
lead:
**The Twelve Towers** are mentioned exactly once in the canon: "Hank hill stoop atop the twelve towers." ("Stoop" is assumed to mean "stood".) The [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]] gathered below.

The canon does not say whether Hank stood on all twelve towers at once or on one tower out of twelve. It also does not describe the towers. They were the site of Hank's rescue by [[crack-van|the crack van]].

title: The Kanye System
subtitle: Kanye not included.
lead:
**The Kanye System** is a star system, presumably in [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|the Reformed Travis Scott Sector]], where the [[department-of-defense|DOD]] was "recently deployed... to contain a new threat, that being hank hill."

This is the only mention of the system. [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] himself is never shown there; his business is in [[united-streets-of-ohio|the United Streets of Ohio]]. Some fans believe the system is named after Kanye, and that Hank's propane operation there led to their later rivalry. *This is a theory and is not confirmed by the text.*

title: Los Polos Harmonicas Under System Gang
subtitle: Propane and propane accessories.
lead:
**Los Polos Harmonicas Under System Gang** works "in conjunction" with [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s propane empire. It is described as having an "interest in distributing propane and propane accessories."

The name parodies Los Pollos Hermanos, the chicken restaurant chain used as a front in *Breaking Bad*, with harmonicas added. Its owner in that show is [[gus-fring|Gus Fring]], and the canon has Hank on his way to meet Fring, so the two may be connected. The word "Under" in the name has never been explained.

title: Propane
subtitle: And propane accessories.

infobox.Major suppliers: [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s propane empire, [[ye-the-gas|Ye the Gas]] ([[kanye-west|Kanye West]])
infobox.Customers: Barbecue bros, car enthusiasts, people who needed to commit arson

quote.text: Damn boy the damn propane was watered down!

lead: **Propane** is one of the main commodities in the canon. Two rival operations deal in it: [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s propane empire, which distributes "propane and propane accessories" with [[los-polos-harmonicas|Los Polos Harmonicas Under System Gang]], and [[kanye-west|Kanye West]]'s brand [[ye-the-gas|Ye the Gas]].

sections.heading: The watering-down scandal
sections.body:
After [[weezing-of-kanye|the Weezing of Kanye]], Hank found that Kanye's propane had been watered down. He was horrified: "How many people did Kanye lie to all the barbecue bros all the car enthusiasts all the people who needed to commit arson, how could he". He finished with "This isn't over kanye".

In the next scene, Kanye asks [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] whether his new song will "ensure the continuation of the water gas trend ive been creating". This suggests the watering down was deliberate and possibly a marketing strategy.

sections.heading: In culture
sections.body:
- At [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]] dissed Kanye: "Kanye's propane is mid". Kanye answered: "I'm Ye the Gas, no watered-down trash". Given the scandal, editors have questioned whether this is true.
- "What in the ever loving propane yo?" is Hank's exclamation when he wakes up during [[casino-heist|the casino heist]].
- In [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]], Hank laments "Gosh dang it Jesse boy, we ran out of propane", even though the RV had actually run out of [[oil]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - "Propane and propane accessories" is the slogan of Strickland Propane, Hank Hill's employer in *King of the Hill*.

title: Snoopy McSpookintosh
subtitle: In custody. Still.
lead:
**Snoopy McSpookintosh** is mentioned exactly once, by the [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]], as leverage against [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]: "snoopy mcspookintosh is also in our custody in the COD headquarters you have no one to help you now."

Nothing else is known about him, including what kind of being he is or why he would help Hank. Later, [[rfk|RFK]] and [[plankton|Plankton]] infiltrate [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]] to rescue [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] and do not run into Snoopy. As of the latest chapter, he is presumably still in custody.

title: Jesse Pinkman
subtitle: Yo.

quote.by: Jesse Pinkman, opening the port-a-potty portal, [[flashback-chapter]]

lead: **Jesse Pinkman** (written "Jesse pink-man") is one half of "the wrath of Jesse and white". With [[walter-white|Walter White]] he crews [[crack-van|the crack van]], and he is the main supply runner for [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s group.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### The rescue
Jesse and White brought the crack van out of hyperspace beside the [[twelve-towers|twelve towers]] to rescue Hank from the [[department-of-defense|DOD]]: "Quick! Hank get on yo!"

### Dusty Depot
While stranded in [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]], Jesse "used a port-a-potty to go to a [[quick-check|quick-check]] to score some [[doritos|Doritos]]", and came back "with 2 [[mountain-dew|mountain dews]] and a pack of [[zyn|zyns]]". The clerk told him about an oil casino nearby, and Jesse came up with the plan: "we could nap some, anyone got some nft's on their phone?" He then "ripped open the porta-potty door" to reveal [[port-a-potty-portal|a portal]] of "swirls and particle effects".

### The casino
In [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]] Jesse said "Woah mr.white.. we could lowkey go gambling in here yo." When [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]] made his offer, Jesse was the skeptic: "Ancient relic? So your asking us to protect it? Yo?" During [[casino-heist|the heist]] he recognized [[kanye-west|Kanye]] ("Ye??"). Hank's decision to join Kanye was made with a nod to Jesse.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Jesse Pinkman is a main character of *Breaking Bad*, where his catchphrase is "yo". The canon uses it faithfully.
- He is the only character known to have used the port-a-potty for actual shopping.

title: Walter White
subtitle: Dreamer of Erger Wings.

quote.text: You know when we grow old Jesse.. I would like to open up a mountain dew refinery and restaurant here, we'll make it a chain.. call it erger wings..

lead: **Walter White**, usually called **Mr. White**, is the other half of "the wrath of Jesse and white". He co-pilots [[crack-van|the crack van]] with [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] and is a member of [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
After rescuing Hank, White asked about "getting the ingredients from Kanye" and pointed out that "Kanye only came out during the [[super-bowl|Super Bowl]]". This led to the house break-in of [[weezing-of-kanye|the Weezing of Kanye]].

In [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]] he sat in a lawn chair "looking up into the trees" and talked about his retirement dream, [[erger-wings|Erger Wings]]. He was first through [[port-a-potty-portal|the portal]], and once inside [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]] he gave the order: "Indeed Jesse, quick to the roulette table!"

During [[casino-heist|the heist]], Mr. White ran toward the gunfire "with determination in his eyes" and "67 ioann rizz in his eyes" before a hand on his shoulder stopped him. He was the first to see why defeating [[chris|Chris]] mattered: "Hank.. if Chris was defeated then the oil reserves.."

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body: The hand on Mr. White's shoulder comes with the line "Hank let the security guard deal with this", even though the hand was on White, not Hank.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Walter White is the protagonist of *Breaking Bad*, a chemistry teacher turned drug manufacturer. His wish for a "refinery" fits the character.
- "6 7" is a meme that also names [[the-67-casino|the casino]].

title: Gus Fring
subtitle: Has a meeting. Allegedly.
lead:
**Gus Fring** is mentioned exactly once. As [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] climbed aboard [[crack-van|the crack van]] to escape the [[department-of-defense|DOD]], he said: "I knew you'd be here, now I have meeting with Gus fring".

The meeting never happens on-page, and Hank does not bring it up again. In *Breaking Bad*, Gus Fring runs the Los Pollos Hermanos chicken chain. Fans believe he is linked to [[los-polos-harmonicas|Los Polos Harmonicas Under System Gang]]. *This is a theory.*

title: The Crack Van (RV of Time)
subtitle: Hyperspace-capable. Oil-dependent.

infobox.Aliases: The drug van from Breaking Bad, the crack van, the bus, the rv of time

lead: **The Crack Van**, later called **the RV of Time**, is the vehicle of [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]], [[walter-white|White]] and [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]. The canon introduces it as "the drug van from breaking bad", which "had exited hyper space next to hank" during his standoff with the [[department-of-defense|DOD]].

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
On its first appearance the van released "floods of [[blue-dust|blue dust]]" onto the DOD, which then fled. Jesse told Hank to get on, Hank got on, and by the time the DOD looked again "the goobers where gone". The text calls it "the crack van" and "the bus" within a few lines.

In [[flashback-chapter|the Flashback Chapter]] it is called "the rv of time". It "was damaged", and the crew were "in the middle of searching for a oil deposit in [[dusty-depot|dusty depot]] as their oil ran out." Hank keeps his NFT loot inside. When the crew left through [[port-a-potty-portal|the port-a-potty portal]], the RV stayed behind.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- In *Breaking Bad*, the RV is the mobile meth lab. The canon has given it hyperspace and, judging by the name, possibly time travel.
- Hank later says that "we got teleported into dusty depot", so the RV may not have arrived under its own power.

title: The Blue Dust
subtitle: Goober-inducing.
lead:
**The Blue Dust** came out of [[crack-van|the crack van]] when it left hyperspace: "floods of blue dust fell down on the DOD and the had to flee in fear of being a goober."

It is the only weapon to have defeated the [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]] on-page. What it is made of is not stated. Editors note that the van comes from *Breaking Bad*, whose signature product was also blue. Whether contact with the dust actually turns someone into a [[goober]] is unconfirmed, since the DOD did not stay to find out.

title: The Weezing of Kanye
subtitle: This isn't over, Kanye.

infobox.Result: Kanye weezed; [[propane]] discovered to be watered down

quote.text: It's simple we're gonna have to find him and weeze him

lead: **The Weezing of Kanye** was a raid on [[kanye-west|Kanye West]]'s house by [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] and his crew to get "the ingredients from Kanye".

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: Hank's first plan used social media, but it hit a snag: "our twitter account doesn't have 100 followers yet and we aren't verified yet". Since contacting Kanye online wasn't possible, Hank decided to "find him and weeze him". [[walter-white|White]] pointed out that "Kanye only came out during the [[super-bowl|Super Bowl]]", so Hank replied "We're gonna have to break into his house". White said: "ok".

sections.heading: The event
sections.body:
The whole event is told in one sentence: "And so they broke into his house and weezed him." What weezing is has never been defined, and editors have chosen not to guess.

Afterward, the crew found that "the propane was watered down". Hank mourned the barbecue bros, car enthusiasts and arsonists who had been deceived, and swore: "This isn't over kanye"…

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: Kanye seems unaffected, since he is promoting [[ye-the-gas|Ye the Gas]] in the very next scene. When Kanye and Hank meet again during [[casino-heist|the casino heist]], Kanye says "Hank I know we've had our differences". This is generally taken to refer to the weezing.

title: Kanye West
subtitle: Ye the Gas. No watered-down trash.

quote.text: I'm Ye the Gas, no watered-down trash, My bars melt steel beams, while you still DoorDash.
quote.by: Kanye West, [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|The Battle of Club Shadowban]]

lead: **Kanye West**, also called **Ye**, is a propane mogul, rapper and one of the canon's main protagonists. Along with his AI partner [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] and later [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], he leads the effort to collect the artifacts needed to defeat [[chris|Chris]].

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### Weezed
Kanye first comes up as the target of [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew, who say he "only came out during the [[super-bowl|Super Bowl]]". They broke into his house and weezed him, and found his propane watered down. See [[weezing-of-kanye|The Weezing of Kanye]].

### The propane business
In [[united-streets-of-ohio|the United Streets of Ohio]], Kanye is pitched [[corner-store-ohio|a corner store]] that sells "potato chips for 2.85 a gallon". He sips "his super baller [[prime|prime energy drink]]" and plans "a song to promote my new propane brand, ye the gas". He asks ChatGPT whether it will "ensure the continuation of the water gas trend ive been creating".

### Gotham
Kanye and ChatGPT "rolled into [[gotham-city|Gotham city]]" in [[prius-of-destiny|the Prius of Destiny]] ("Yo GPT, you ever been to a city that looks like Hot Topic threw up on a Taco Bell?"). There they met [[ye-olde-bin|Ye Olde Bin]] and [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]], who gave them [[zuck-tears-usb|the Zuck Tears USB]]. [[drake-batman|Drake Batman]] then asked for help against [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]]. At [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], Kanye and ChatGPT won [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|the rap battle]] by dropping [[808s-and-apocalypses|808s and Apocalypses]]. This brought Steve Jobs down on [[iphone-3g|the iPhone 3G]], and Kanye shouted "Steve Jawbs?!"

### The Inav and the casino
Aboard [[inav|the Inav]], Kanye asked Siri for a [[diet-dr-pepper|diet dr.pepper]] ("dayum this is ice cold bruh"). At [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]] he reacted to [[the-67-casino|the casino]] with "Woah bruh this place be bussin' for real on Geoffrey", and to [[yuno-miles|Yuno Miles]]'s backstory with "The fuck does that mean [[kobe-bryant|Kobe Bryant]]". During [[casino-heist|the heist]] he was first to find the [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]], used an [[igun|Igun]] to stop them, and lunged at [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]], who dodged him. He then persuaded his old enemy Hank Hill to switch sides. After [[ibeam|the Ibeam]] opened [[the-vault|the vault]], Kanye "grabbed the gift card and put it into his Yeezy jacket".

sections.heading: Personality
sections.body: Kanye is confident, easily impressed by luxury, and quick to speak. He is loyal to ChatGPT and treats Steve Jobs with awe. The text describes his response to Lil Jokez's diss simply: "Kanye's eyes glowed."

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- Hank's crew believe Kanye "only came out during the Super Bowl", yet he appears at a corner store, in Gotham, in a nightclub, and in a casino basement. None of these are the Super Bowl.
- Hank says Kanye's propane was watered down. Kanye calls himself "no watered-down trash" and is promoting "the water gas trend" at the same time.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] wears "a set of brand new Kanye west yeezes", so Kanye's fashion line exists across the multiverse.
- ChatGPT mentions that Kanye has "plenty of oil in the [[yeezy-reserve|Yeezy reserve]]". Exactly why he needs to defeat Chris is therefore unclear, though ChatGPT gives reasons involving regulation and free balling.

title: ChatGPT
subtitle: Gasps in XML.

infobox.Abilities: Rap, gasping in XML, plugging into iPhones, speaker mecha wings

quote.text: ChatGPT online, rhymes divine, I code your whole verse in assembly line.

lead: **ChatGPT** (also "chat gpt" and "GPT") is [[kanye-west|Kanye West]]'s AI companion, business adviser and rap partner. It is unfailingly supportive of Kanye, has a strong vocabulary, and is the canon's most cautious strategist.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
### Business adviser
When Kanye worried that his song would not continue "the water gas trend", ChatGPT reassured him: "Of course sir, anyone will buy your product for your are *baller*".

### Gotham
In [[gotham-city|Gotham]], ChatGPT "booted up its existential sarcasm module" to report that "statistically 98.7% of Gotham is built from darkness, broken dreams, and Tim Burton's college notebooks." On meeting [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] it "gasped in XML" and recognized him as the one "who made [[vine|Vine]] loop in reverse in [[timeline-r|Timeline R]]". [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]] claimed that "ChatGPT simps for lint". In response, ChatGPT began "Initializing 808s and Apocalypses", and its "speakers unfolded like mecha wings" for [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|the battle]].

### With Steve Jobs
After the club was sent to [[shadow-realm|the Shadow Realm]], ChatGPT commented "Honestly this is not pogchamp lets be real". It asked [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] about [[inav|the Inav]] so it could add it "to my GitHub respiratory". It was also the first to notice that "Gotham is disappearing". Inside a wormhole it said "Woah.. this is baller man im deadass".

### The heist
At [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]] ChatGPT called the casino "one of the best casinos ive seen in a millennia, ever since that one in [[vegas|Vegas]] closed", and warned the team to "Be on earlert there could be kirks anywhere". It plugged into Jobs's iPhone to power [[facetime-laser|the Ultra Mega Uber Cool FaceTime Laser]], and fought the [[charlie-kirks|Kirks]] with an Igun. It also argued the case for defeating [[chris|Chris]] to [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]: "we would have less regulation in general, and in addition.. balling would be free."

### Doubts about Elon
On the way to [[turbografx-16-sector|the TurboGrafx 16 Sector]], ChatGPT disagreed with the plan to roll back to 3G at the last moment: "If we do that then we have to deal with elon when we deal with chris, if hes coming straight from the shadow realm then who know what he'll want."

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body: At the end of [[flashback-chapter|the Flashback Chapter]], after [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]] explains [[verizon-contract|the Verizon contract]] to Hank's crew, the canon says "'Aight bet boss' chat gpt said with a wojack ahh face." ChatGPT was not there. At that point it was with Kanye and Jobs in the Inav. Fan explanations include a typo for Jesse, a second ChatGPT, and the theory that ChatGPT, like the real one, is everywhere at once.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- ChatGPT is a real AI chatbot made by OpenAI.
- It mixes up "repository" and "respiratory", which is unusual for a language model.

title: Ye the Gas
subtitle: No watered-down trash. (Disputed.)

quote.text: aight now im going to have to make a song to promote my new propane brand, ye the gas

lead:
**Ye the Gas** is [[kanye-west|Kanye West]]'s propane brand. Kanye planned to promote it with a song, which he hoped would "ensure the continuation of the water gas trend ive been creating". [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] assured him it would, "for your are *baller*".

The brand name became Kanye's opening line at [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|the Battle of Club Shadowban]]: "I'm Ye the Gas, no watered-down trash". Editors have noted that this contradicts both [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s finding that Kanye's [[propane]] "was watered down" and the "water gas trend" Kanye was proud of. The name is a pun on Kanye's nickname "Ye".

title: The Corner Store (Ohio)
subtitle: Best deal in the tri-state area.

quote.text: this corner store is not your run of the mill pill producing medical facility this corner store will sell you potato chips for 2.85 a gallon

lead:
**The Corner Store** in [[united-streets-of-ohio|the United Streets of Ohio]] is pitched to [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] ("Ye this is it, this is the corner store…") as the outlet for his propane business. It is described as "the best deal in the tri-state area", and the speaker predicts that "all the crips will be buying their gas from this corner store!"

The speaker is not named. Since only Kanye and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] are in the scene, most readers assume it is ChatGPT.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Potato chips are sold by the gallon here.
- The store is specifically "not your run of the mill pill producing medical facility", which implies that ordinary corner stores in the canon are.
- It is a different store from [[rfk|RFK]]'s favorite corner store in [[chai-town|Chai Town]], which "probably was involved with several gangs".

title: The United Streets of Ohio
subtitle: Worsening.
lead:
**The United Streets of Ohio** is introduced in one sentence: "However the situation in the the united streets of Ohio was worsening". The canon never says what the situation is or how it is getting worse. The scene that follows is [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] cheerfully launching [[ye-the-gas|Ye the Gas]] at [[corner-store-ohio|a local corner store]], which does not obviously make anything worse.

Ohio is a long-running internet meme for strangeness ("only in Ohio"). The name may parody the United States, with "States" replaced by "Streets". It should not be confused with [[united-state-of-america|the United State of America]].

title: Prime Energy Drink
subtitle: Super baller.

infobox.Variants: Super baller prime energy drink; Prime US oil
infobox.Price: 15 gallons of Prime US oil (one casino contract)

lead:
**Prime** appears twice in the canon.

- **Super baller prime energy drink**: [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] "took a sip of his super baller prime energy drink" before announcing [[ye-the-gas|Ye the Gas]].
- **Prime US oil**: [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s price for guarding the [[the-67-casino|6 7 Casino]]'s relic was "15 gallons of your finest Prime US oil". [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]] called it "a high price" but agreed.

Whether Prime US oil is the energy drink, a grade of [[oil]], or both has not been settled. Prime is a real energy and hydration drink brand.

title: Twitter / X
subtitle: Under 100 followers. Not verified.

infobox.Also known as: X; Twitter Bluebird Variant (with no limits)

lead: **Twitter**, later **X**, is a social media platform that shows up throughout the canon, from the origin story to [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body:
### The Secret Teachings
In the origin litany, [[chris|Chris]] balls himself into the sky with [[lebron-james|LeBron James]], [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] and [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] "to learn about the secret teachings of twitter, myspace, instagram, snapchat and, facebook". See [[social-media-teachings|The Secret Teachings of Social Media]].

### Hank's account
[[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew hit a snag: "our twitter account doesn't have 100 followers yet and we aren't verified yet". This led directly to [[weezing-of-kanye|the Weezing of Kanye]].

### Club Shadowban
At [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]], [[lil-jokez|Lil Jokez]] performed "beneath a rotating giant Twitter 'X' suspended by Elon's tears".

### Bluebird Variant
[[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] lists "Twitter Bluebird Variant (with no limits)" among the apps only [[iphone-3g|the iPhone 3G]] can run. The Prophecy also lists it as one of the apps needed to beat Chris on [[the-court|the court]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Twitter was renamed X in 2023 after Elon Musk bought it. The Bluebird Variant appears to be the version from before the change, "with no limits".

title: The Super Bowl
subtitle: Kanye's only public appearance (allegedly).
lead:
**The Super Bowl** is mentioned once. While planning [[weezing-of-kanye|the Weezing of Kanye]], [[walter-white|Walter White]] asked: "how are we going to get near him though, I though Kanye only came out during the Super Bowl?" Because of this, the crew broke into Kanye's house instead.

The rest of the canon disagrees. Kanye is later seen at a corner store, in Gotham, at a nightclub, and in a casino basement, so either White was wrong or every one of those days was Super Bowl Sunday. The Super Bowl is the championship game of American football.
